tooltip.pneumaticdiversityvents.vent_seg: Aperture's patented steel-and-glass tubing capable of holding a vacuum.
- Crouch-place a second segment to create a longer varient.
- Crouch-place a third segment to create a 90-degree bend, given that exactly one of the existing segments' openings is occupied.
- Airflow can be inspected using the PortalMod wrench.
actionbar.pneumaticdiversityvents.impell: Power setting set to 'switch between on and off'
tooltip.pneumaticdiversityvents.vent_imp: The Encouragement Impeller removes non-essential social barriers from the Diversity Vent's interior, such as 'atmospheric pressure', and 'breathable air'.
- Each additional impeller in a vent network increases the force across the network. Three impellers are required to lift and transport the player.
- Attach an antline indicator to enable powered test-element mode.
- The PortalMod wrench can be used to toggle the impeller polarity and change the impeller's powered vs unpowered behaviour.
actionbar.pneumaticdiversityvents.termin: Set to default appearance (no indicator lights)
Set to indicate any non-zero airflow
tooltip.pneumaticdiversityvents.vent_ter: Focuses the suction zone at a vent opening to a narrower, stronger, and longer-reaching cone.
- The PortalMod wrench can be used to cycle through indicator settings.
tooltip.pneumaticdiversityvents.vent_enc: A single full-block Diversity Vent segment for aesthetic purposes.
tooltip.pneumaticdiversityvents.vent_sca: Powers connected antlines when it's configured target crosses the scanner.
- Use the PortalMod wrench to switch between cube and player detection.
actionbar.pneumaticdiversityvents.juncti: Default travel set to straight through
Fixed opening set to positive direction
Fixed opening set to negative direction
tooltip.pneumaticdiversityvents.vent_jun: Powered two-route T-junction for controlling vent routing.
- Use the PortalMod wrench to change which opening is fixed and which is variable.
- Crouch-click with the wrench to change which route is open by default.
- Crouch-place a segment out of the junction to redirect it's alternate opening.
advancement.pneumaticdiversityvents.too_: Hit the speed cap while traveling through a Diversity Vent.
advancement.pneumaticdiversityvents.dont: Fall to your death from a Pneumatic Diversity Vent. (All diversity excursions are voluntary, and Aperture Science is not liable for personal harm up to and including death by diversity vent)
